disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean, median and maximum lead, cadmium, mercury and arsenic in cattle, pig, horse and poultry muscle and liver and in raw cow milk from the Polish national residue plan 2008-2012.

study.design: National residue monitoring survey (Poland National Residue Control Plan) of slaughtered-animal tissues and raw cow milk, 2008-2012
study.origin: Poland (animals slaughtered and milk produced in Poland)
study.market: samples collected by the Veterinary Inspection under the National Residue Control Plan (not retail)
study.method: Pb and Cd by graphite furnace AAS after dry ashing at 450 C; As by hydride generation AAS after magnesium nitrate ashing at 550 C; Hg by AMA 254 mercury analyser
study.lod_text: Cd detection limit 0.001 mg/kg (Results); LOQ Hg 0.001 mg/kg, As 0.002 mg/kg (Results); Pb limit not printed (values printed as <0.002)
study.qa: National Reference Laboratory; EURL proficiency tests with z-scores between -2 and +2; no CRM recoveries printed

controls.outcome: Cd mean cattle liver 0.119 vs muscle 0.003 mg/kg; pig liver 0.045 vs muscle 0.001; poultry liver 0.052 vs muscle 0.001; Pb cattle liver 0.083 vs muscle 0.018 mg/kg

controls.control: species (horse vs cattle and pig muscle)
controls.outcome: Cd mean horse muscle 0.052 vs cattle 0.003 and pig 0.001 mg/kg; 22 horse muscle samples above 0.20 mg/kg ML

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU Commission Regulation (EC) 1881/2006 maximum levels used
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Pb meat 0.10, liver 0.50, milk 0.02 mg/kg; Cd meat 0.05, horse meat 0.20, liver 0.50 mg/kg

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Table 2: EU non-compliant results under Directive 96/23/EC 2009-2011 (quoted from EFSA reports)
regulatory_or_exposure.value: counts and percentages only; not concentrations

unresolved: Per-year means appear only in Figures 1-4 (bar labels); not extracted.
Milk lead maximum 0.190 mg/kg would exceed the 0.02 mg/kg limit; text and Table 1 both say one milk sample exceeded, consistent.
Hg and As limit values in Table 1 footnote refer to Polish national action levels not printed in the paper.
Lead LOD/LOQ not printed; <0.002 used as the censoring bound.
